sections.content: Use experience questions and answers with vocabulary for the beach, sea and excursions. Ask about places visited, activities done and things seen. Use *alguna* *vez* for the question and *nunca* for a negative answer.

items.english: Have you ever visited the coast?
I have never visited the coast.

items.spanish: ¿Has hecho alguna vez una excursión al mar?
items.english: Have you ever taken an excursion to the sea?

items.spanish: Sí, he hecho una excursión al mar.
items.english: Yes, I have taken an excursion to the sea.

sections.content: *alguna* *vez* only ever shows up in the question that opens the door; the answer, positive or negative, never repeats it — sí or *nunca* alone carries the weight of the reply.
